description: Get the Learning Workflow Graph for the session as a normalized GraphView with LIVE per-concept state (mastered/current/available/locked) from the learner's running mastery. Shape: {schema, domain, title?, nodes:[{id,type,label,group?,state?,value?}], edges:[{id,source,target,type}], focus?, legend?}. A graph webview repaints this each turn; the same payload drives a teacher (full) or student (ego) view. null when the bundle has no LWG. Also returns concept_map, the learner's map drawn from what this session served and how it was answered (studium/concept-map/v1): nodes with state acquired/to_review/current/seen/upcoming and the questions asked with their step, prerequisite edges, position {from, at, next}, a Mermaid flowchart and display_markdown. Show it when the learner asks where they are; start_lesson_session and submit_response already carry it at the moments worth showing it. null for a review session or a lesson with fewer than two concepts.
name: get_workflow_graph
